sourceOccurrences.label: Exponential decay
sourceOccurrences.note: Spatial and cluster-volume decay statements must retain their respective hypotheses.

sourceOccurrences.label: Uniqueness of the phase transition
sourceOccurrences.note: The Duminil-Copin–Tassion and Aizenman–Barsky approaches can be represented as different routes to related conclusions.

sourceOccurrences.label: The finite-size criterion and sharpness
sourceOccurrences.note: The finite-range spatial-decay conclusion must not be promoted to a general long-range spatial-decay statement.
